title: Asiad: Kurt Barbosa adds another silver to PH haul
summary: Veteran campaigner Kurt Barbosa settled for a silver medal in the 2026 Asian Games after being outplayed by Kazakhstan's Tamirlan Tleules in the final of the men's -58kg class on Friday night.
